Certain to deliver hours of entertainment, you can configure it in a variety of different layouts, from a house to a car (two additional circle cushions required) or, of course a classic sofa! Plus, it’s suitable for indoor or outdoor use, so you can place it in your little one’s bedroom or introduce it to your outdoor space.

products.product_title: Stockholm 6 Seater Black Rattan Corner Garden Dining and Lounge Set
products.description: Enhance your outdoor living area with the Stockholm Lounge Set in Black, a luxurious and versatile 6-seater rattan collection that combines functionality with style. Featuring a spacious corner sofa with black removable seat and back cushions, this set provides the ideal space for relaxation and entertaining. Paired with a rectangular rattan dining table, it’s versatile enough for al fresco dining or casual lounging. Whether hosting a sophisticated outdoor dinner or enjoying a relaxed gathering, the Stockholm Lounge Set elevates your outdoor space with its practical design and elegant appearance.
